## Learning goal

I can separate what must be true from what would simply make the design better.

## Sort the criteria

- **Requirement:** something the solution should accomplish.
- **Restriction:** a limit the design must work within.
- **Necessity:** a requirement or restriction that must be satisfied. Score it **10/10**.
- **Nice-to-have:** a useful improvement that is not required. Score it **1-9/10**.

A necessity is not just something you strongly prefer. If it is missing, the design fails or cannot be used safely and appropriately.

## Quick test

For each criterion, ask: **Would the design still work without this?** If yes, it is probably a nice-to-have.

[Sort the criteria in the N.I.C.E. Needs Worksheet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19ObkJz3sYVXwB9VkNUiybXZGZ-ihuGw1FarRj81LtAo/edit).
